name: beadup-academy-template
description: Kids abacus & mental math training center website template (Bootstrap 5).

scripts.build:css: cleancss -o assets/css/style.min.css assets/css/style.css && cleancss -o assets/css/dark-mode.min.css assets/css/dark-mode.css && cleancss -o assets/css/rtl.min.css assets/css/rtl.css
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/main.js -c -m -o assets/js/main.min.js && terser assets/js/dashboard.js -c -m -o assets/js/dashboard.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
